messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — need to lock dependency ordering for the batching MVP. Eng slipped 2 sprints; aiming for a trimmed v1 in ~6 weeks. Key deps: runtime batching API, infra GPU reservation, security KMS + cache threat model. Who can commit?

Andre (Eng - Runtime): I can do 20m after standup. Question: expose batch-hint header now or keep auto-only? Auto ships faster but increases runtime edge cases.

Leah (Infra): We have a small reserved GPU slot week 3; to guarantee sustained throughput reserve in wk1. Finance warns ~40% bump. Tagging @finance-team.

Sam (Security): KMS-only review is ~3 business days. HSM/on-prem adds ~2w. Need threat model for per-tenant KV cache and audit logs.

Nikhil (Eng-SRE): Canary OK at 5%. Need rollback playbook. Suggested alert thresholds: P95 > 200ms or error rate > 1%.

Maya (PM): Proposed compromise: v1 = auto-batching + hidden opt-in header (feature flag). Define rollout gates and acceptance criteria?

Andre (Eng - Runtime): Acceptance criteria proposal:

```
- Auto-batching behind FF
- Optional batch-hint header implemented
- P95 <= 220ms at target qps in canary
- No regressions on QA prompt subset
- Graceful fallback to solo requests
- Runbook + staged rollback tested in staging
```

Leah (Infra): Need target qps to size pool. Maya, confirm traffic profile. Recommend staged reservation: small pool wk3, scale wk5 if metrics OK.

Maya (PM): Initial customer cohort peak ~150 qps for short sequences. I'll upload traffic spreadsheet today.

Sam (Security): For threat model: require encryption-at-rest (KMS) and key usage audit logs. KMS-only acceptable for v1. I'll start the review once key usage pattern is confirmed.

Andre (Eng - Runtime): Implementation question: per-tenant KV cache node-local or shared? Node-local reduces cross-tenant leakage but needs eviction/warm-up.

Leah (Infra): Node-local acceptable if ephemeral and wiped on termination. We'll add lifecycle hooks. Shared persistent cache is follow-up.

Nikhil (Eng-SRE): Canary plan:
- Week 4: staging synthetic load 1.2x expected qps for 24h
- Week 5: 5% prod traffic for 48h
- Monitor P50/P95/P99, error rate, token cost delta
- Rollback criteria: P95 > 220ms or error spike > 0.8% sustained 10m

Maya (PM): Owners & deadlines:
- Andre: runtime FF + header + fallback — PRs by Fri EOD
- Leah: reserved capacity plan + cost scenarios — Tue EOD
- Sam: KMS review + threat model — Wed EOD
- Nikhil: canary runbook + alerts — Thu
- Maya: QA prompt subset + traffic spreadsheet — Today

Andre (Eng - Runtime): I'll add short repo doc and perf script.
Leah (Infra): Adding cost scenarios, tagging @finance-team :eyes:
Sam (Security): Reminder: scrub PII before sharing token-level logs. Adding checklist.

Maya (PM): Treat this as official sequencing plan. Next sync Thu 11:00 to confirm PRs and infra slot. Thanks!

Andre (Eng - Runtime): :thumbsup:
Leah (Infra): :+1:
Sam (Security): :white_check_mark:
Nikhil (Eng-SRE): On it.
DevX-bot: Created ADAPT-BATCH-42 (assignee: Maya)
